tools.name: consult_invoice
tools.description:
Look up an invoice's current status by its access key.

Read-only: it never changes the document.

tools.name: cancel_invoice

tools.name: get_invoice_pdf
tools.description:
Return the printable rendering of a document, as a PDF.

Works for both types — a DANFE for nfe, a DANFSe for nfse. The PDF
comes back base64-encoded in content_base64; the XML, not this, is
the legally valid document. A 502 from here means the authorizer is
unavailable, not that the invoice is wron

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description:
List the invoices this company issued, newest first.

One document type at a time: pass nfse for services or nfe for
goods. A company that issues both has to be asked twice.

Use it for "my last invoices", "what was rejected today", and to find
